dict.string: Liftr uses your location during outdoor cardio to measure distance while the workout timer is running.
Liftr uses HealthKit to read workouts, routes, body weight, and related data from Apple Health so you can import cardio and track weight history in Liftr.
Liftr may attach GPS workout routes to existing Apple Health workouts when routes are missing from Garmin or other wearables. Liftr does not create new workouts or change calories or duration.
